body.html: The first thing guests mention is the clean rooms and the low price. SC Residence Mukdahan is a small residence of around 36 rooms in the Anurak alley area of central Mukdahan. Many reviews say you get a clean, cold, quiet room with free parking at guesthouse prices — good value for drivers or anyone using Mukdahan as a stopover before crossing into Laos.

Rooms are simple but complete. Each has air-con, a satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, a tea/coffee maker, a wardrobe and an en-suite bathroom with hot water and towels. Most reviews praise the cleanliness and comfortable beds, though they're honest that these are budget residence rooms — not new or luxurious, just clean and functional for the price.
"Clean room, cold air-con, quiet, easy to park, kind staff — great value at this price for a place to sleep in town in Mukdahan."

What lifts the scores here are the in-town location and free parking. It's on a quiet alley, but a few minutes' drive gets you to the markets, restaurants and the Mekong riverfront. There's a 24-hour front desk and daily housekeeping, and staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful — a good fit for travelers who want a clean, cheap base in town.

The trade-offs come from real reviews too. This is a budget property: no pool, no on-site restaurant, and not a riverside stay. Breakfast usually isn't included, so you head into town to eat. The residence sits down an alley with a small sign, and some first-timers struggle to find the entrance — keep a map app open. Review counts on the platforms are still thin, so treat the scores as drawn from a small sample.

On crossing into Laos: the residence is in central Mukdahan, about a 10–15-minute drive to the Second Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge and the crossing to Savannakhet. That makes it handy for travelers using Mukdahan as a stopover before the border, running cross-border errands, or driving on through lower Isan. You sleep in town near the markets and the river, then drive to the border in the morning — easier than staying far out.

The honest summary: SC Residence Mukdahan suits travelers who want a clean room, cold air-con and free parking on a budget as an in-town base. For roughly ฿450–฿700, a clean room in a spot that's easy for both town and the border is good value in Mukdahan. But if you want a Mekong view, a pool, or a hotel with full facilities, choose a riverside hotel or a higher-tier place in the town center instead.

A tip from reading a lot of reviews: navigate into Anurak alley with a map app, and check whether breakfast is included before you book. If you're crossing the border early, have your documents ready and ask the property about border opening hours in advance. During local events or festivals, rooms fill fast — book 1–2 weeks ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate.

faq.q: Where is SC Residence Mukdahan, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's on Anurak Alley 2 in central Mukdahan. It's about a 5–7-minute drive to the Indochina Market and the Mekong riverfront, about 5 minutes to the town center and restaurants, and a 10–15-minute drive to the Second Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge and the crossing to Savannakhet.

faq.q: How much does SC Residence Mukdahan cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start at about ฿450/night, in double and twin layouts. There's a larger Superior room and a Family Room, rising to about ฿850. Prices vary by date — always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does SC Residence Mukdahan have parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both. It has free on-site parking and free Wi-Fi in all rooms, plus a 24-hour front desk and daily housekeeping — convenient for drivers who want a clean base in town.

faq.q: Who is SC Residence Mukdahan best for?
faq.a: It's well suited to travelers who want a clean room, cold air-con and free parking on a budget as an in-town base before crossing to Savannakhet or driving on. If you want a Mekong view, a pool, or full facilities, choose a riverside hotel or a higher-tier place in the center instead.

faq.q: Is it easy to cross into Laos from SC Residence Mukdahan?
faq.a: Yes. From the residence it's about a 10–15-minute drive to the Second Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge and the crossing to Savannakhet. That makes it a handy stopover for travelers using Mukdahan as a gateway, running cross-border errands, or driving on through lower Isan — have your documents ready and check border opening hours in advance.

faq.q: Does SC Residence Mukdahan serve breakfast?
faq.a: Mostly breakfast is not included and there's no on-site restaurant. But the in-town location means breakfast spots, cafes and markets are a short drive away. Double-check the breakfast terms when you book.
